project_name: Sistem Manajemen Toko HP & Toko Online

data_numbers.usage: IMEI, Prices (Rp), Financial Data, Serial Numbers in Admin Panel

rules: Avoid Inter, Roboto, and generic sans-serifs completely.
Never center-align paragraphs; prioritize left-alignment for readability.
Use uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines and tiny labels.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border. Inner borders on surfaces for crispness.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient layered shadows. Avoid flat drop-shadows. Use shadow-sm for cards, shadow-xl for modals.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-xl for storefront cards, rounded-md for admin dashboard density.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise on dark mode backgrounds or hero sections. No large generic purple gradients.

grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: High-density grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel matters. Cardless data tables where possible to reduce box-in-box UI.
grids_and_layouts.storefront: Bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12). Wide gaps (gap-8). Asymmetrical hero sections. Overlapping elements to create tension.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous padding for containers (p-6, p-8). Mobile-first padding is critical (p-4 for small screens).

components_instructions.buttons: Real buttons only. No 'fake' text-only clickable spans. Storefront CTAs should have micro-interactions (hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98]).
components_instructions.inputs: Shadcn UI inputs. High contrast borders. Focus state must use ring-2 with primary brand color.
components_instructions.tables: Shadcn UI table for Admin. Must be responsive with horizontal scroll on mobile.
components_instructions.modals: Dialog for IMEI Camera Scan. Must overlay cleanly and provide 'Tutup' button clearly.
components_instructions.toast: Use Sonner for notifications ('Berhasil disimpan', 'IMEI tidak valid').
components_instructions.status_badge: Must use the exact status_colors defined above. Add subtle dot indicator inside the badge for visual pop.
components_instructions.date_format: Must strictly follow DD/BULAN/YYYY (e.g., 09/OKTOBER/2026). BULAN must be uppercase Indonesian.

motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform. NEVER use 'transition-all'.
motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must change color or slightly elevate on hover.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in-up for catalog grids (framer-motion or simple CSS animations).

accessibility.contrast: Text must pass WCAG AA. Ensure labels are legible over inputs.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid="btn-login", data-testid="input-imei").
accessibility.mobile: Tap targets minimum 44x44px. Camera scan button must be thumb-accessible at bottom of screen.

products_premium.description: Green premium smartphone close-up for hero banners
Orange smartphone camera array for feature highlights

store_context.description: Modern white retail store for about us or background sections

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a full-stack Hybrid app (Admin + E-commerce). Do NOT mix the UI paradigms. Admin should be dense and functional, Storefront should be spacious and emotional.
ALL text, placeholders, and error messages MUST be in Bahasa Indonesia. Example: 'Masuk' instead of 'Login', 'Keranjang' instead of 'Cart'.
For the Admin Inventory table, ensure 'Pencarian IMEI' and 'Status' filters are easily accessible.
Implement the 'Scan Kamera' feature for IMEI input inside a modal dialog using a web camera library or basic HTML5 capture input for mobile.
Generate code in .js (JSX) format, NOT .tsx. Provide the proper component installation commands (npx shadcn-ui@latest add button, etc).
Do NOT add text-align: center to the root App class. Maintain left alignment by default for human reading flow.
Use data-testid on every clickable element and form input for testing purposes.
Luhn validation must be implemented on the client-side for IMEI inputs before submission.
No generic AI purple gradients. If you need gradients, use subtle monochromatic or brand-accent washes.
Ensure the UI layout is truly Mobile-First (Android), meaning touch targets must be large enough and complex tables must be scrollable.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate (e.g., sticky headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). This breaks transforms.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Missing image categories = use the provided images. NEVER use placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
